title: Minister father, Baptist church and getting his first drums
summary: His father was a Baptist minister, no one played music, and Foster sang in church. He crossed the lake and got drums, his first instrument.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: 1904. Yes. Did your parents play any music, your father or mother or anyone else in the family?
No. Well, it was just a northern minister.
Do you remember, what kind of a church was it?
It was a Baptist. Baptist. Yes, Baptist Church of Manville, Louisiana.
Do you remember any special music in the church when you were young? What kind of music and singing they had?
No, I sang in the church. You did sing? Yeah, in Baptist Church. Yes. In Manville, Louisiana. Then I stayed at the Arnold Turtle during the year of, I'll say, about 22. See?
You stayed over on that side of the lake?
Yeah. And I came in to a north here. Went to work. Then I got drums. See?
Were the drums your first instrument?
Drums were first instrument, yes. Oh, yeah. Drums were really first instrument.
